about: NavisLabs SOCIAL V1 audit (scripts/build-social-audit.py). V7 = investor/product demo; SOCIAL V1 = attention + product thesis + proof.

flags.SOCIAL_FORMAT: TRUE — 4:5 · H.264 High · yuv420p · 30 fps · AAC 48 kHz stereo 320 kb/s

flag_reasons.SOCIAL_DURATION: Inside the 65–70 s brief; the founder's lines play at natural speed (no stretching), with shortened pauses only.
flag_reasons.SOCIAL_FORMAT: 1080×1350, 30/1 fps, h264 High yuv420p ~3871 kb/s (CRF 16), aac 48000 Hz 2 ch; faststart.
flag_reasons.RESOLUTION: Native 1080 × 1350 render of the reframed V7 picture (via a 1.5× sharpened proxy of the V7 1080p master).
flag_reasons.VOICEOVER_READY: The founder's own P1/P2/P3/P4/P6/P8 recordings, unmodified and not regenerated: 19 social lines (26 of V7's 43 lines) cut at measured line boundaries with 20 ms fades; no speed change or stretching. Onsets within 44.8 ms of plan; A/V offset 18.7 ms.
flag_reasons.MUSIC_READY: The edit is done (the founder-supplied Eleven Music track re-cut into four sections that follow the brief's arc; ducked under every line, deeper under key lines, near-silence after 'NavisLabs.', a slow decay to silence). FALSE because the track's licence tier is still NOT VERIFIED and it needs the founder's listening approval.
flag_reasons.SFX_READY: 35 subtle cues on visible actions only, but they are the in-project synthesized placeholders (TEMPORARY) — no ElevenLabs SFX were supplied.
flag_reasons.CAPTIONS_READY: Burned in (≤ 2 lines, ≤ 34 characters per line, 44 px on an 80 % plate, 132 px above the bottom edge, inside 4:5 safe areas); the thesis lines are carried by the on-screen type and the last two lines by the end card. social-captions.srt / .vtt / .json carry every spoken line (word timings in .json).
flag_reasons.VISUAL_QC: 2098/2098 frames; no stray black frames (one planned 6-frame dark beat before the mark); held frames decode identically to the frame before them (largest step 0.04/255); no repeated frames at cuts; soft frames only inside V7's own transitions; every framing checked on stills.
flag_reasons.AUDIO_QC: -14.0 LUFS integrated, -1.2 dBTP, 0 clipped samples, LRA 2.9 LU; voice 12.59 LU over music under speech (17.32 LU under key lines); no unexpected silence or level jumps; the only silence is the planned end.
flag_reasons.MOBILE_READABILITY: Captions (44 px ≈ 16 pt on a phone), the thesis type (60–78 px) and the end card read on a phone. Product UI is legible on a phone where the reframe is a macro (systems list, trace pills, Approve & send, Connect cards, context table, AUTHORIZED card); V7's small UI text in the wide moments (scatter, app intro, the thesis picture) is texture on a phone — the captions and type carry those beats.
flag_reasons.FINAL_SOCIAL_READY: FALSE until the founder approves this cut, the music licence is confirmed, the temporary SFX are replaced or accepted, and the V7 data noted under remaining problems is accepted for public posting.

Navis turns those signals into one shared understanding.
Inside a company, the Navis App is for people.

Every fact has its source, its time, and how fresh it is.
The same company's agents use Navis Developer.
Connect once — through MCP, API, SDK or CLI.
The agent asks — and gets the company's context, with sources and freshness.
The agent does the work, and the run is on record.
Same facts. Same sources. Same freshness. One understanding. Two ways in.
The shared understanding for your organization.

Still visible: 'SALESFORCE Opportunity · closes Nov 14' and 'JIRA KVR-142 · Blocked' chips in the App (≈17.3–20.8 s), 'Renewal call · Oct 9' (V8: Thu, Oct 8) and 'Committed 9 days ago' (V8: 6 days ago) in the App (≈18.6–20.8 s), and 'salesforce · as_of 09:44' in the Runs page's run detail (≈55.4–56.2 s); the scatter shot's flying fragments name Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft 365, Jira and Zoom as tools where work happens (≈4.2–5.7 s). If these must not appear publicly, the cut can be re-sourced from the V8 picture (same plan) — not done because the brief makes V7 the source of truth.
